name: Sofia Leone
source:
Ruler of the Big Breasts Tribe's EQ Area.

A native of Italy responsible for the EQ Union Area.

Of noble birth and great capability, Sofia is well trusted by the soldiers.
She speaks in a superior tone and is good at leaving her opponents off-balance.
She favors the status quo.

From Mangagamer.
